scene.note: server.js now receives readings from the volunteers' phones, checks each one, keeps the good ones and answers in JSON.

steps.note: A phone at the north tap sends a reading, and its body arrives in pieces.
The server waits for every piece, joins them, and reads the whole body as JSON.
It keeps the tap and the litres, nothing else that was sent.
It answers that the reading was created, with the reading it kept, as JSON.
Imran asks how much each tap has used.
The server adds up the litres of each tap from the readings kept so far.
It answers with one total per tap, as JSON, and an empty object before any reading.
A phone loses signal halfway, and only part of a reading arrives.
Reading it as JSON fails, and the server catches the failure instead of stopping.
It answers that the request was wrong, says why in JSON, and keeps nothing.
A body keeps coming, far longer than any reading, without saying how long it is.
The server counts the bytes as they arrive and stops reading once they pass its limit.
It answers that the body is too large, keeps nothing, and goes on serving the next phone.
